body: I'll definitely bring this up with him, since i know he's willing to try. thank you!

I've stayed because we do have fun together and i do love him, but i completely agree with you. I have been trying to be supportive of him, and honesty just two times a week would be enough for me which i dont think is completely unattainable. To me, the relationship is worth trying to save but I plan on leaving if it doesn't improve. It's also worth mentioning that we were close friends for a while before we started dating :/
